question: Please book the Keck-I telescope for 2025-11-14 for 4 hours. During my last visit I used the H-alpha filter and had a support astronomer, though I won't need any filters or staff assistance this time around.

function.name: reserve_spectrograph_filters
function.description: Reserves a set of optical filters for a specific booking ID.

filter_names.description: List of filter band names (as strings) to reserve.

question: For booking OBS-8821, I need to reserve the U-band, B-band, V-band, and R-band filters for our upcoming photometry run.

function.name: cancel_observation_run
function.description: Cancels an existing observatory reservation by its booking ID and logs the reason.

booking_id.description: The unique booking ID to cancel.

reason.description: The brief stated reason for cancellation.

question: Please cancel booking ID BK-9045 due to instrument failure, and then automatically rebook me for the next available clear night in December and email the department head.

function.name: request_liquid_nitrogen
function.description: Orders a specific volume of liquid nitrogen for CCD cooling at a specific dome.

dome_number.description: The integer number of the observatory dome.

liters.description: The volume of liquid nitrogen needed in liters.

question: Hey there! It's been a crazy week up here on the ridge. The weather was super windy on Tuesday, and my grad student accidentally spilled coffee all over the control room logs while we were hunting for that supernova. Anyway, before I forget, our cryostat is running warm so we need 25.5 liters of liquid nitrogen delivered to dome 3 as soon as possible. Thanks a bunch!

function.name: calibrate_adaptive_optics
function.description: Schedules a laser guide star calibration prior to an observation window.

elevation_angle.description: The target elevation angle in degrees.

exposure_seconds.description: The calibration exposure duration in seconds.

question: Working on Proposal 4092 at the 4200-meter summit with our 8.2-meter mirror, please calibrate the adaptive optics on Subaru at an elevation angle of 65.4 degrees for 120 seconds.

function.name: register_visiting_astronomers
function.description: Registers a list of visiting researchers for summit dormitory access under a grant code.

visitor_names.description: An array of full names (strings) of the visiting astronomers.

dietary_restrictions.description: Optional dietary restrictions for the summit kitchen. Omit if none.

question: Under grant code AST-773, please register Dr. Elena Vance, Prof. Marcus Chen, and Sarah Jenkins for summit dormitory access; none of them have any dietary restrictions.

function.name: slew_dome_to_azimuth
function.description: Rotates the specified observatory dome to a target azimuth angle.

azimuth_degrees.description: The target azimuth angle in degrees (0 to 360).

park_after_slew.description: Optional flag to lock and park the dome after slewing.

question: At 23:15 UTC, we are tracking asteroid 99942 Apophis which is currently 14000000 kilometers away, so please slew Dome-B to 214.8 degrees azimuth, and definitely do not park it afterward since we need continuous tracking.

function.name: extend_observation_window
function.description: Requests an extension for an active telescope session in minutes.

extra_minutes.description: The number of additional minutes requested.

question: We are right in the middle of capturing the transit light curve for exoplanet WASP-12b, and the seeing just dropped to a phenomenal 0.4 arcseconds! Could you extend session SES-551 by 45 minutes, and also process the raw FITS files for flat-fielding right away?

function.name: schedule_mirror_recoating
function.description: Books maintenance downtime for recoating a telescope's primary mirror.

start_date.description: The start date of the maintenance in YYYY-MM-DD format.

days_required.description: The number of days the telescope will be offline.

coating_material.description: Optional coating material (e.g., 'aluminum', 'protected silver'). Only specify if decided.

question: We need to schedule mirror recoating for the Gemini-North telescope starting on 2026-05-10 for 14 days; the committee debated between aluminum and protected silver, so leave the coating material unspecified until they finalize the decision next week.

function.name: book_control_room_workstation
function.description: Reserves a computer workstation in the observatory control room for a specific shift.

workstation_id.description: The integer ID of the workstation terminal.

observer_email.description: The email address of the observer.

shift_type.description: The shift period, such as 'first-half', 'second-half', or 'full-night'.

question: Oh man, you wouldn't believe the traffic getting up the mountain road today, there was a herd of mountain goats blocking the hairpin turn for like twenty minutes! Anyway, I finally made it to the summit lodge and unpacked my gear. I just need to book workstation 7 for a full-night shift under my email address k.takahashi@astro.edu so I can set up my scripts before sunset.
